Have you ever prayed the same prayer so many times you're tired of hearing yourself?
How long will you forget me?
How long will you hide your face?
How long will my enemy win?
Then he asks God to look at him,
And then one small word turns the whole psalm:
"But I have trusted in your steadfast love."
He just doesn't let it have the last word.
Then write one line under it that starts with "but."
